statement_blocker: The Stage1-bearing catalog record says only 'a layered algorithm for maximum flow'. It does not define the network, capacity and flow domains, source/sink hypotheses, residual semantics, level graph, blocking flow, state update, output, correctness theorem, termination argument, implementation version, or exact polynomial bound. A companion non-Stage1 computer-science record lists O(V^2 E) and O(V E log V) without distinguishing variants, while publisher metadata only confirms separate 1970 original-paper and 1983 dynamic-tree bibliographic entries. The primary texts and the bound-to-variant mapping were not inspected. Selecting a precise proposition now would invent, merge, or substitute mathematics.
target_decision: retain the Dinic/Dinitz layered maximum-flow correctness-and-complexity family at provisional H1/M4/R4, freeze no canonical proposition, and require primary-text review plus explicit original/dynamic-tree/specialized-variant reconciliation
domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source must fix a finite directed network or edge-indexed multigraph, vertex and edge universes, distinguished source and sink, capacity codomain, flow and residual representations, level/blocking-flow state, executable or relational semantics, and the cost/input-size model.
